name: IconButton
description: `IconButton` is a button whose only content is an icon. `aria-label` is required, because the control has no visible text.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the button. Required, because the icon alone conveys nothing to assistive technology.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: description
props.description:
Supplementary text shown in the button's tooltip and exposed as its accessible description. Without it, the
tooltip repeats `aria-label` visually.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon to render: a component such as an Octicon, or a rendered element. Pass an element when the icon comes
from a Server Component.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.

props.name: keybindingHint
props.description:
Keyboard shortcut, or alternative shortcuts, shown in the tooltip, such as `Mod+B` or `['Mod+B', 'Control+B']`.
Displays the hint only; the consumer still registers the shortcut.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the button is loading.

props.name: notificationIndicator
props.description:
Shows a dot for new activity on the button boundary or on the icon. The dot is not announced, so describe the
activity in the accessible name or description.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the button.

props.name: tooltipDirection
props.description: Side and alignment of the tooltip relative to the button.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Icon shown at the far end, conventionally a chevron for a button that opens something.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button behavior. Use `submit` to submit a form.

props.name: unsafeDisableTooltip
props.description: Skips the default tooltip. Prefer keeping it; IconButton also skips it automatically inside an existing Tooltip.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the button. Use `primary` for the main action and `danger` for a destructive one.
